summary: Aegon Ltd. furnished a routine Form  ＜6-K＞ carrying interim half-year ＜2026＞ financial statements and disclosures, including segment results, solvency ratio estimates, and restated 1H2025 comparatives reflecting Aegon UK as discontinued operations. The filing notes the AGM approved a proposed item on ＜June 10, 2026＞. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed; the only discontinuation reference is accounting presentation of the previously announced UK separation, not a new special situation. Watch for solvency and discontinued-operations detail in future filings.
